name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Biological Sciences research doctorate, admitting students with a funding plan and either a faculty match or first-year rotations.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Department states recurring date without entry year. Special spring/summer admission requires individual faculty request.

applicationFee.note: Central fee reinstated effective August 1, 2026, $50 per primary application. Graduate School does not grant individual applicant requests for waiver; no Biology-specific offer established.

english.toefl: 600 paper /250 computer-based, as biology bulletin publishes; no department iBT equivalent established
english.note: Biology bulletin requires IELTS 7 for non-native English speakers, higher than general minima used elsewhere. International central requirements/exemptions page could not be opened; no exemption inferred. Central application page says language scores valid two years.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial upload); international credentials require course-by-course NACES evaluation, with evaluation, transcripts and degree proof sent by the evaluator
Supplemental information sheet in application portal
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s or equivalent with adequate biological-sciences preparation; normally science GPA 3.0, with flexible review of slight deficiencies. Contact prospective faculty or indicate first-year rotation interest. Major professor/advisory committee chosen first year. GRE status not established from opened department/bulletin pages; program-requirements profile inaccessible.

funding.note: Admission only with financial support. Most students have departmental TA or faculty RA support; independent NSF/Fulbright or other external support also accepted. This establishes required support, not guaranteed university funding for every admitted applicant.
